title: Masonry in buildings less than three stories in height in structural occupancy category I, II, or III.
officialText: The minimum special inspection program for structures classified as structural occupancy categories I, II, or III, in accordance with Table 1604.5, which are three stories or less in height, shall comply with Table 1704.5.1.
